replicated_originals.reference: Yasuda, Ito, Matsumoto et al. (2025) Proposal for a Novel Classification of Patients With Enlarged Ventricles and Cognitive Impairment Based on Data-Driven Analysis of Neuroimaging Results in Patients With Psychiatric Disorders, Neuropsychopharmacology Reports 45(1): e70010

A.reason: This is ref [6], the authors' previous study, which found the EVCI subtype (EVCI in 27% of EV individuals, mostly schizophrenia, mostly male) in the Osaka cohort. The present paper, titled 'A Replication Study', re-tests that finding in the remaining 146 EV individuals from 13 other COCORO cohorts and concludes it 'validated the existence of the EVCI subgroup in independent cohorts' (a self-replication, which the codebook includes).

B.reason: This is a correction notice for the EVCI case series (ref [19], e70029). The paper cites the case series itself only as background on the clinical features of EVCI. It never cites the correction, and neither notice is a replicated finding.

notes: Self-replication of Yasuda et al. 2025 (ref 6) using new cohorts. Okada et al. 2023 (ref 10) is the source of the ventricular-volume data and method, not a replicated original.
